bullets.text: Proactive Defense Guide Released - **Microsoft** unveils a new e-book on enhancing security through exposure management maturity.
OpenClaw Security Risks Highlighted - New insights reveal significant risks associated with deploying **OpenClaw** in unguarded environments.
Windows 11 Insider Preview Update - New optional build 29531.1000 released for **Windows 11** Insider Canary Channel users.
Carbon Negative Milestone Achieved - **Microsoft** successfully matches 100% of its electricity consumption with renewable energy by 2025.
Windows 11 Builds Released - **Microsoft** announces new builds 26100.7918 and 26200.7918 for the Release Preview Channel.
New Insider Preview Build Launched - **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 26220.7859 now available in the Beta Channel.
MIDI Support Enhanced in Windows 11 - **Windows 11** now supports both MIDI 1.0 and 2.0, boosting music production capabilities.
SOC Fragmentation Costs Revealed - New research from **Microsoft** highlights the operational costs of fragmented security operations.
